Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data and at least one additional factor related to user interaction with the content.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and further comprising: analyzing user engagement metrics to inform the modification of the rule on probability factor.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data, the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and additional contextual data regarding user preferences.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, wherein the composition of the rules is further informed by historical performance data of similar content attributes.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance, and wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data and additional user interaction data.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data, the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and contextual data regarding user engagement with the content.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; determining, by the processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data, the second aggregated performance data, and additional contextual information regarding user interactions with the content.
